_doc: B05 hub tiers for the staged voice pipeline, milliseconds. Built on islab/voice/latency_config.json (B01) without editing it: 'common' stages not listed here come from B01. A stage is either absolute {p50, p95, source} or {scale_measured: f, source} = this CPU's measured p50/p95 times f. 'this_cpu' stages are filled at run time from experiments/b05_pipeline/measured.json. Every 'assumption' is NOT measured: no Raspberry Pi 5, mini PC or GPU was available to us, and no LLM weights could be downloaded (huggingface.co blocked).

pi5_cpu.label: Raspberry Pi 5 class box (4x Cortex-A76 2.4 GHz, 8 GB), CPU only
pi5_cpu.cpu_note: assumption: CPU-bound stages run 2.5x slower than on our measured 2 vCPU x86 box (per-thread A76 vs cloud x86)

wake_detect.source: assumption: detection delay is set by the model's window, not compute (compute RTF here 0.03; x2.5 still real time)

vad_endpoint.source: assumption: endpoint delay is the hangover setting, not compute

stt.source: assumption: measured CPU STT final lag x2.5

tts_first_audio.source: assumption: measured Piper low first-sentence time x2.5

llm_ttft.source: assumption: 1B-class Q4 LLM on Pi 5 CPU, cached system prompt

minipc_cpu.label: x86 mini PC (4-8 cores, e.g. N100 to Ryzen 7 class, 16 GB), CPU only
minipc_cpu.cpu_note: assumption: CPU-bound stages run like our measured 2 vCPU box (scale 1.0)

stt.source: assumption: same as measured CPU STT

tts_first_audio.source: assumption: same as measured Piper low

llm_ttft.source: assumption: 1-3B Q4 LLM on mini PC CPU, cached system prompt

minipc_gpu.label: x86 mini PC + local 12 GB GPU
minipc_gpu.cpu_note: assumption: wake word, VAD, grammar and policy on CPU as measured; STT, TTS and LLM on the GPU (B01 x86_gpu12gb assumptions)

stt.source: assumption: Whisper small/turbo class on GPU, decode after endpoint, short command

tts_first_audio.source: assumption (B01 x86_gpu12gb): neural TTS on GPU, first sentence

llm_ttft.source: assumption (B01 x86_gpu12gb): 7-8B Q4 fully on GPU, cached system prompt

this_cpu.label: This machine: 2 vCPU x86 cloud VM, no GPU (measured stages from measured.json)

llm_ttft.source: assumption (B01 devbox): no LLM weights obtainable offline
